business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Armored Security Personnel Transport Vehicles

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: U.S.-influenced common law corporate statutes combined with customary land and family law recognized under the RMI Constitution.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (1983, amended 2003), providing economic cooperation and certain investment-related protections rather than a conventional bilateral investment treaty.

No standalone comprehensive double taxation agreement or dedicated bilateral investment treaty has been ratified by the Republic of the Marshall Islands for general foreign investors; treaty-based investment protection is therefore limited except where expressly provided under the Compact and related bilateral instruments.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act (Marshall Islands Revised Code, as amended through the Business Corporations Amendment Acts); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act (AMLCFTA), as amended; Beneficial Ownership Regulations issued pursuant to the AMLCFTA; and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit Customer Due Diligence Guidelines.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not required for domestic registry use; if presented to a foreign bank or government, certified copy must be legalized through RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs or apostilled when accepted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporator and Notary Public of the signatory jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or, for non-Apostille countries, RMI consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration / Beneficial Ownership Register Extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed RMI registered agent or RMI FIU-approved compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or RMI consular legalization where supporting identity documents require authentication.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport, government-issued identity, and proof of address of each director, officer, and 25% or greater UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national issuing authority or notary public of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / criminal record certificate of each director, officer, and UBO

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or RMI consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-wealth statement for UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing regulated bank or financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus apostille or consular legalization where required by the recipient bank or RMI FIU.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for all UBOs, directors, officers, authorized signatories, settlement counterparties, and end-user/end-use parties in respect of ISIC 3040 Manufacture of Armored Security Personnel Transport Vehicles. Screening is required against the RMI FIU domestic watchlist, OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions, U.S. BIS Entity List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions list, and other competent domestic listings. The engagement shall be classified High_Risk_Special_License; a source-of-funds certificate and end-use/end-user certification must be completed before any government-direct-wire or diplomatic LC payment rail is approved. Positive PEP identification requires senior management approval and enhanced ongoing monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Corporate Registry — Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro; filings and name reservations are submitted through a licensed RMI registered agent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the operative registry language. Corporate names must use Latin alphabetic script and be distinguishable from existing registered names. If a proposed name includes foreign-language characters or transliteration, a Latin-script transliteration and an English translation must accompany the filing; a secondary foreign-language name may be recorded but not as the sole official corporate name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is not automatically renewable; the applicant may refile a new name reservation within the 30-day validity window. If the Registrar rejects a name, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar within 14 business days of the rejection notice, annexing the rejection letter, a corrected name analysis, and any consent letters from holders of conflicting names. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may petition the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands under the applicable Administrative Procedure Act within 30 days of the Registrar's final decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only in the narrow sense that a non-resident Business Corporation may use the physical address of its licensed RMI registered agent as its statutory registered office without maintaining separate premises. A purely virtual arrangement without a licensed RMI registered agent is not permissible. If the company later performs RMI-relevant income-generating activity or creates substantial presence in the Marshall Islands, economic substance rules will require a real office, personnel, and decision-making presence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk for a high-risk defense-related exempt company is estimated at 15% during the first 24 months in respect of registered-agent due diligence files and statutory records; unannounced on-site inspection probability increases to approximately 30% if government payment rails or diplomatic letters of credit are used or if the RMI FIU receives a suspicious transaction report from a counterparty bank.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per certified translation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Sections 301 (Incorporation), 302 (Articles of Incorporation), 313 (Bylaws), 322 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 341-344 (Directors and Officers), and Part III (Shares and Capital)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Registrar Division
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital requirement; the corporation must file a Certificate of Authorized Shares and evidence of consideration paid, if any, with adoption of an initial capital contribution resolution and corporate bank escrow instructions in accordance with the MBCA
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription agreement of the incorporators for 1,000,000 authorized common shares, par value $0.001, is accepted and the officers are directed to issue share certificates upon full payment. RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be maintained at the address of the corporation's licensed registered agent, with the registered agent named as custodian of corporate records. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following persons are appointed directors and officers of the corporation: [Name] as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, [Name] as Chief Financial Officer, and [Name] as Corporate Secretary, each to serve until the next annual meeting, with full authority to execute formation filings and diligence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a corporate name reservation request through the designated filing service provider or directly with the Registrar, confirming the name is distinguishable and not misleading for a military tactical vehicle manufacturer. Submit a certified copy of the tax-exempt status letter if applicable.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, the applicant must file an amended reservation with a new name or provide additional distinguishing elements within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Articles of Incorporation Filing and Statutory Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Registrar Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Articles of Incorporation, including the corporate purpose and authorized shares clause, together with the required filing fee. If the Articles are accepted, the Registrar will issue a Certificate of Incorporation and assign the corporation identification number.
required_dossiers: Organizational Chart and Registered Agent Acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises a defect, the applicant must file curative amendments and resubmit within 10 business days; any rejection notice must be remedied by corrected filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws and Issuance of Shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting of the incorporators or initial directors. The directors must adopt the Bylaws, ratify the issuance of share certificates, and execute the initial capital contribution ledger.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the initial directors fail to adopt the Bylaws or issue shares, the incorporator may call a special meeting of incorporators to ratify corrective actions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The initial directors must execute the Appointment of Directors and Officers form, designating the Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Corporate Secretary, and any other required officers, and file the first board resolution with the corporate records.
required_dossiers: Appointment of Directors and Officers Form
Consent to Act as Director or Officer
Certified Copy of First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer is disqualified, the board must convene a special meeting and appoint a qualified replacement within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Registered Agent Designation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar Division, Registered Agent Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Change/Designation of Registered Office and Registered Agent form, attaching proof of a duly licensed registered agent and a physical address in the Marshall Islands for service of process.
required_dossiers: Designation of Registered Agent and Registered Office
Certificate of Licensing of Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent withdraws or the office is invalid, the corporation must appoint a new agent and file the change within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Exemption Registration and Special Defense License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Tax and Customs Authority and Ministry of Defense
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation as a Non-Resident Business Corporation and obtain the eligibility certificate for the exempt tax regime. For manufacturing of military tactical vehicles, apply separately to the Ministry of Defense for a Special Defense Industry License. Initiate the High-Risk Special License process in accordance with the Defense Industry Control Act.
required_dossiers: Share Ledger and Beneficial Ownership Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the license application is questioned, the company must provide supplemental compliance evidence and undergo enhanced due diligence review within 15 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a notice of incorporation in a local newspaper designated by the Registrar, and obtain an annual good standing certificate after each fiscal year end, together with the annual report filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In the event of late filing or publication default, the corporation must pay a reinstatement fee and file corrected documentation within 12 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshall Islands Ministry of Resources and Development, Industrial Licensing Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Special Defense Industry Manufacturing License for Heavy Tactical Vehicles

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report Required for manufacturing processes involving metal fabrication, surface coating and high energy testing; registration required for limited assembly
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge standards require pH 6.0-9.0 and oil/grease below 10 mg/L; VOC emissions must be controlled to below 50 mg/Nm3; hazardous waste handling must meet RMI Hazardous Waste Regulation Schedules and Ozone Depleting Substances standards

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the RMI Fire and Rescue Service; structural load inspection certificate from the Ministry of Public Works for factory floor loading; and Workplace Safety Clearance from the Occupational Safety and Health Office for permissible exposure limits on metal dust, noise, and motor vehicle assembly operations

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Customs Office (RCO), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro; corporate registry portal: Office of the Registrar of Corporations via the official RMI government internet portal (rmi.gov.mh); no dedicated tax e-filing portal (paper-based filing).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate as a Business Corporation (BC) under the Business Corporations Act 1990 through a licensed registered agent; the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation bearing a unique corporate registration number. Step 2: No TIN or VAT ID is issued at incorporation; a non-resident BC deriving no Marshall Islands-source income has no national tax registration obligation. Step 3: If local-source business is undertaken, file Form GRT-1 with the RCO to obtain a Gross Revenue Tax (GRT) Account Number and remit the 3% GRT. Step 4: For defense settlements, open a local banking account; banks require the Certificate of Incorporation, register of directors, registered agent letter, and beneficial-ownership declaration under the AML regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: A non-resident Business Corporation is exempt from national income, gross revenue, capital gains, and withholding taxes on all income sourced outside the Marshall Islands. Territorial scope: only Marshall Islands-source revenues are potentially taxable; zero effective rate on offshore manufacturing and export sales of military tactical vehicles; no comprehensive tax treaties in force.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist in the RMI tax code. Statutory options: (1) election to be treated as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990, the practical route to full tax exemption for foreign-owned export manufacturers; (2) election to register for GRT for any Marshall Islands local-source revenue; (3) project-specific tax exemption certificates granted by the Cabinet to internationally oriented export businesses. No pass-through entity classification election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT or GST in force; indirect taxation is imposed solely through customs import duties and selective excise under the Customs Ordinance 1990, plus the 3% Gross Revenue Tax on local business turnover; a VAT reform has been discussed but is not enacted.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. Indirect-tax obligations arise only at customs clearance; the 3% GRT applies from the first USD 1 of Marshall Islands-source gross revenue, yet a non-resident export manufacturer with no local-source revenue has no registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, digital stamping, or tax-authority API mandate. Customs declarations are lodged through the ASYCUDA World electronic clearance platform; export invoices follow commercial practice without state clearance gateway.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: with no VAT/GST, export sales of armored vehicles and offshore services are outside the indirect tax base; there is no 0% claim, refund, or input-credit mechanism. Imported components used for re-export may qualify for duty drawback under the Customs Ordinance subject to proof of physical export; defense exports are duty-neutral at the border.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (lodged via ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading / Waybill evidencing physical departure from the RMI customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT MT103-equivalent proof of payment
Commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin
End-User Certificate and destination export-license evidence for military tactical hardware (UN embargo screening)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The RMI imposes no statutory FX repatriation deadline (USD is legal tender and no exchange-control statute exists); the 180-day window reflects standard settlement terms for government wire and diplomatic LC payments. Fraudulent customs declarations attract forfeiture of goods, penalties up to three times the duty evaded, and criminal liability (fine and/or imprisonment) under the Customs Ordinance 1990; drawback refunds are retrospectively clawed back with interest upon false or withdrawn export claims. Defense-sector transactions face enhanced AML/CFT scrutiny, and falsified beneficial-ownership or end-user documentation can trigger corporate deregistration and custodial penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Banking Commission (Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance) as the licensing and prudential regulator; no statutory central bank exists. The US Federal Reserve System serves as the de facto monetary and settlement authority because the US Dollar (USD) is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility in law and practice: RMI maintains no exchange-control statute and no capital-versus-current-account distinction; the US Dollar is the domestic currency, so profit remittance and dividend repatriation by non-resident Business Corporations are free of conversion, approval, or surrender hurdles. The only practical constraints are AML/CFT verification obligations under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2001 (FTRA), US correspondent-bank policy, and enhanced due-diligence expectations for defense-sector flows, which may require certified board resolutions, source-of-funds evidence, and export-licence references.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or conversion rules apply. Export receipts may be retained indefinitely in any currency and are not subject to any mandatory timeline, minimum conversion ratio, or repatriation threshold; because the manufacturer bills predominantly in USD, export proceeds are credited directly to the RMI bank account with no exchange-conversion requirement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch (Majuro)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Private Escrow Services

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. RMI law (Banking Act 1991) recognizes only licensed banks and has no electronic-money institution (EMI) license class, so offshore digital EMIs cannot lawfully hold deposits or execute payments from an RMI nexus. An offshore EMI may be used only as an auxiliary non-RMI collection channel if it holds a credible US or EU licence, but this route creates heightened correspondent, sanctions, and trade-based AML risk for ISIC 3040 defense flows and is not recommended as a primary clearing rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is effectively mandatory. At least one authorized director or signatory must attend an in-person interview at a branch in Majuro (Bank of Guam or BMI) with original passport, wet-ink account mandates, board resolutions, certificate of incorporation, and the FTRA beneficial-ownership schedule; remote account opening is de facto unavailable for a high-risk defense manufacturer unless the bank accepts a diplomatic or notarial attestation, which remains discretionary and rare.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership through nominee directors and a non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 51, RMI Revised Code, as amended) registration certificate; full register of directors, officers and shareholders; FTRA Schedule 1 ultimate beneficial ownership declaration for all natural persons above 10%; notarized passports and utility bills; group organizational chart signed by all UBOs; and a board resolution confirming economic substance and intended transaction purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Defense-tactical manufacturing classification (armored security personnel transport vehicles) triggering sanctions, export-control, and predicate-offense red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid export licence or ITAR/DDTC exemption where US-origin or US-content applies; Wassenaar-compliant end-user and end-use certificate; restricted-party screening report covering OFAC, UN, and EU consolidated lists; signed procurement contract identifying an eligible government or diplomatic buyer; and a compliance manual documenting dual-use and military end-use screening procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value inbound wires or documentary credits from government or diplomatic counterparties requiring enhanced due diligence and source-of-funds verification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed purchase order or ministry procurement contract; commercial invoice and packing list; bank-specific EDD and source-of-funds questionnaire; historical MT103 evidence of counterparty funding; proof of prior licensed export transactions; and a sworn declaration of lawful source of funds stamped by the licensed corporate secretary.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is routed as USD wire via SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the parent shareholder's bank through US correspondent clearing (Fedwire/CHIPS), most efficiently via Bank of Guam's US network or BMI's New York correspondent. The credit is applied directly to the RMI operational account with zero local conversion. The wire narrative should include the entity ID, the capital-contribution purpose, and the sending bank's applicable purpose code (typically GRF for investment/equity contribution or ANN for payments on behalf of the company). The bank must receive a board resolution authorizing the injection, the share certificate or subscription ledger, the FTRA EDD pack, and a source-of-funds statement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements settle through (i) SWIFT MT103 direct wires for the Government_Direct_Wire rail to ministries and prime contractors; (ii) commercial documentary letters of credit (sight or term 'D'/'C' LC) for supplier payments on the Diplomatic_LC rail, issued via Bank of Guam and confirmed by a US or EU bank; and (iii) SWIFT MT700/MT707 messages for LC issuance and amendment. Every outward payment is bundled with the commercial invoice, bill of lading or air waybill, packing list, inspection certificate, and, where the counterparty is a government or diplomatic mission, a diplomatic-endorsed delivery note to mitigate trade-based financial crime risk. All MT103 traffic must carry the true transaction narrative and, where applicable, the permitted export-licence reference.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright forwards (USD/EUR, USD/GBP, USD/AUD, USD/JPY) with internationally rated banks, executed offshore because RMI has no local forward market.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in restricted currencies (USD/CNY, USD/KRW, USD/INR) booked through Singapore or Hong Kong trading desks.
Cross-currency swaps (USD versus EUR, USD versus GBP) matched to long-term defense procurement and repayment schedules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Filing (Business Corporations Act 1990, Part VIII)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 of each calendar year, referencing the corporation's authorized capital schedule and anniversary month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of US$300 plus 1% per month interest after April 30; continued failure for 90 days after notice results in administrative dissolution or strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Specialized License Annual Renewal for Manufacture of Armored Security Personnel Transport Vehicles (Defense Tactical Hardware)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RMI Ministry of Commerce and Trade / Trade and Licensing Board, with AML/CFT supervisory oversight
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal window opens 60 days before expiration date; license must be renewed before its anniversary date to maintain authorized operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operation without a renewed license is subject to administrative stop orders, fines up to US$10,000 per month, and referral for suspension or revocation of the license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO / AML Compliance Confirmation (Shareholding and Beneficial Ownership Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent, on behalf of the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and Registrar of Corporations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the annual report filing deadline (April 30), or within 21 days of any change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-confirmation may suspend registered agent services, expose officers or owners to fines up to US$5,000, and be recorded as a compliance deficiency affecting corporate standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Office Continuation Confirmation, Including Directors' Consent Records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent; filed with the Registrar of Corporations whenever agent or director details change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual report, or within 30 days of any director resignation, appointment, or agent change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of registered agent or unpaid government fees permits the Registrar to dissolve the corporation after 30 days' written notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit required for corporations with annual gross revenue of US$5 million or more, or holding a special government license involving defense manufacturing or dual-use goods, or subject to enhanced AML/CFT due diligence under RMI regulations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB; RMI domestic GAAP, substantially converged with US GAAP, is permitted for non-public, non-licensee entities that do not meet the audit threshold.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every share transfer during the year must be recorded in the share ledger and reflected in the annual UBO confirmation. The registered agent must obtain and retain ownership schedules identifying natural persons with more than 10% ownership or controlling influence; any shareholding transfer requires submission of an updated confirmation to the registered agent within 21 days of transfer registration.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $1,200-$2,500 annually for a licensed RMI registered agent with AML compliance services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $12,000-$25,000 annually for a certified RMI/US CPA firm audit under IFRS

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3.0% — flat corporation tax on gross revenue derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Title 54 MIRC, Income Tax Act 1989); non-resident offshore Business Corporation: 0.0% effective rate on all non-RMI-source revenue
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0.0% — Tax_Exempt_Zone classification applicable to non-resident domestic Business Corporations; full territorial exclusion of foreign-derived revenue; no capital gains tax, no estate or gift tax, no undistributed profits tax, and no branch remittance tax for the offshore BC; no discretionary tax holidays exist, the territorial exemption being the operative incentive
corporate_income_tax_regime.regime_structural_notes: The RMI corporate tax base is RMI-source GROSS REVENUE, not net profit; net operating loss carryforwards are therefore structurally inoperative under RMI law, and the 5-year figure is recorded solely as a conservative planning assumption for foreign tax-credit and foreign group-offset purposes, not as a statutory RMI NOL right. A pure non-resident BC with no RMI nexus has no RMI income tax filing obligation, but must still pay the annual Registrar of Corporations franchise/government fee (approximately USD 600-1,000 depending on authorized capital) and maintain a licensed registered agent to remain in good standing.
